subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should OpenClaw first expose deterministic sub-agent announce suppression as a per-spawn routing mode, and should it also add a persistent `agents.defaults.subagents` default?
rationale: The issue asks for a new public tool/config contract, and the related parent-routing and per-channel requests show that the choice determines future API shape, scope, and compatibility rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Per-spawn routing enum first
options.body: Add an explicit per-spawn policy with the current channel behavior as the default and a deterministic skip mode, leaving persistent and per-channel policy to later evidence-backed follow-ups.

options.title: Per-spawn plus global default
options.body: Ship a per-spawn override and a backwards-compatible default under `agents.defaults.subagents`, accepting the larger schema, documentation, and upgrade surface now.

options.title: Consolidate with broader routing design
options.body: Pause implementation until the owners combine this skip request with the parent-routing contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/27445.

recommendation.title: Per-spawn routing enum first
recommendation.body: Add an explicit per-spawn policy with the current channel behavior as the default and a deterministic skip mode, leaving persistent and per-channel policy to later evidence-backed follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history supplied with the issue places the primary spawn and announce-delivery boundary with this contributor.
